792-1531-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
792-1531-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Deathgreeter, Totentanz and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Deathgreeter trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Totentanz ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Deathgreeter triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

141-1070-5686.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1070-5686.description:
Cast Rise Again by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Rise Again.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Naru Meha, creating a Blood token.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Rise Again
Resolve the Rise Again copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-4289-6633-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

2038-4499-7824.description:

Repeat.

624-670-1619-1974.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Quicksilver Gargantuan and Phantasmal Image each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Quicksilver Gargantuan trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Phantasmal Image trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.

624-670-1619-1974.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.

Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by The Earth Crystal.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 9 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

2906-4050-4907-6989.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
2906-4050-4907-6989.description:

240-1251-4050-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding one mana of any color
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

240-2511-5470-7175.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.

When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Repeat from step 2.

4067-6609-7314.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a nonland permanent you control

1494-3923-4613-7152.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Thing.
1494-3923-4613-7152.description:
Cast Mystic Speculation with buyback by paying {2}{U}, returning it to your hand.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Thing's first ability triggers, putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Declare The Thing as an attacker. Its second ability triggers, causing you to pay {R}{G}{W}{U} to double the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate The Thing using Sage of Hours' ability by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
1494-3923-4613-7152.notes: You can cast any noncreature spell in lieu of Mystic Speculation. Mystic Speculation is strongly recommended as it guarantees you can cast a noncreature spell each turn, but you may omit it at your discretion.

Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.

1387-1500-2100-5195-6596.description:
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {R}. Storm-Kiln Artist, Blood Funnel and Hermes trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.

1479-3875-5700-5701-6664.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3875-5700-5701-6664.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

11-4493-5195-6526.manaNeeded: {U}{R}{W} plus enough mana to cast the spell that creates a token copy
11-4493-5195-6526.description:
Cast Flamehold Grappler by paying {U}{R}{W}.
When Flamehold Grappler enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next spell you cast this turn.
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying its mana cost, targeting Flamehold Grappler.
Flamehold Grappler and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Flamehold Grappler trigger, copying Irenicus's Vile Duplication, with the copy targeting Flamehold Grappler.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Irenicus's Vile Duplication, creating a token copy of Flamehold Grappler.
When the token Flamehold Grappler enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next spell you cast this turn.
Holding priority, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Irenicus's Vile Duplication
Flamehold Grappler and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Flamehold Grappler trigger, copying Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand and creating a copy of Narset's Reversal targeting Irenicus's Vile Duplication.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Narset's Reversal copy, returning Irenicus's Vile Duplication to your hand and creating a copy of Irenicus's Vile Duplication targeting Flamehold Grappler.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Irenicus's Vile Duplication copy, creating a token copy of Flamehold Grappler.
When the token Flamehold Grappler enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next spell you cast.
Activate up to four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding enough mana to cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication.
Repeat from step 3.

Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.

628-2018-5147.description:

Resolve the undying trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if the creature is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

Abdel Adrian and Shipwreck Dowser trigger.

Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Planar Incision.

Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.

1349-1999-2034-2793-5089.description:

Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.

Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it and returning Ugin's Nexus to your hand, choosing to not put an artifact onto the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.

When Realm-Scorcher Hellkite enters the battlefield, it and Genesis Chamber trigger.
Resolve the Realm-Scorcher Hellkite trigger, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Genesis Chamber trigger, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Realm-Scorcher Hellkite, adding {C}{C}.
When Realm-Scorcher Hellkite dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning it to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1984-2048-3454-4406.manaNeeded: {2}{R}{W} the first turn, with {10}{R}{R}{W}{W} available each extra turn
1984-2048-3454-4406.notablePrerequisites: Sunforger attached to a creature you control.
1984-2048-3454-4406.description:
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Chance for Glory and casting it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Chance for Glory, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Chance for Glory on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to a creature you control.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to a creature you control.
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Angel's Grace and casting it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Angel's Grace, preventing you from losing the game this turn.
Activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Angel's Grace on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your end step, Chance for Glory triggers, however you cannot lose the game due to Angel's Grace.
Repeat from step 4.

628-2034-2781-3305.notablePrerequisites: Felidar Guardian does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-2034-2781-3305.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Felidar Guardian, adding {C}{C}.
When Felidar Guardian dies, its undying ability and Body Launderer's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Body Launderer trigger, causing it to connive.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Body Launderer.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Felidar Guardian, adding {C}{C}.
When Felidar Guardian dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing it to connive.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger from step 5, blinking Body Launderer.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Body Launderer, adding {C}{C}.
When Body Launderer dies, its undying and second ability triggers.
Resolve the undying trigger,  returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the second Body Launderer trigger, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking any other permanent you control.
Repeat.

570-1636-4630.notablePrerequisites:
Faeburrow Elder does not have summoning sickness.

570-1636-4630.description:

Activate Sisay by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, searching your library for a legendary creature card with mana value less than Sisay's power and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the legendary creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.

1023-1769-2201-4727.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
1023-1769-2201-4727.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
Rot Hulk dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Rot Hulk's enter the battlefield trigger is put onto the stack.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, returning Rot Hulk and Vengeful Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Rot Hulk and Vengeful Dead die as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
The Vengeful Dead and Rot Hulk triggers are put on the stack.
Resolve the Vengeful Dead trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 4.
